text: I feel stirred by curiosity as I step into this crisp, modern space. The glass walls and clean lines around me inspire a sense of clarity and openness; I sense the possibility of innovation. Moving closer to the vibrant display with its R+D motif, I am enveloped by an atmosphere charged with intellectual energy. Here, the promise of research and development pulses like a quiet invitation—to question, to explore, to co-create. I feel eager to participate in this interplay of discovery and thought.
